desc:
🎃 HALLOWEEN UPDATE 🎃
Check out spooky items in shop, and watch for new in-game hazards.

If you can't see the other ship, turn up your graphics! 📷

Dive into the midst of destruction on the high seas!
Experience the brutal effectiveness of modern naval warfare as you bombard the enemy battleship with turrets, machine guns, and cannons.

Sink them before they sink you!

Press Ctrl or right-click in first-person to zoom.

Recent updates:
> Halloween Update
> Redesigned all the guns and two of the ships
> Fixed a bug where mobile users can't press some on-screen buttons
> Enabled July 4th accessories

Join our discoard to report bugs or suggestions!
